_comment: #1587: make verify and CI consume this source-path verdict without independently resolving promises.
Cases build checkout-shaped assets in a temporary directory. The production default floor is exercised, not overridden.
Population is extracted from cpp:init, never from a separate product manifest. Generated, consumer and external targets are reported but unverified.
The constructed anchor represents the prior absence of a check; provenance is unverified, not historical. Each bad case must make it BLIND.
Bounds: source existence does not prove registration, executable permissions, network readiness, generated content, or completion of a disclosed step.

cases.name: bad-missing-helper
cases.why: A promised CPP helper is absent, while 43 other supplied paths resolve.

cases.name: bad-real-hooks-json
cases.why: The unfixed Tier 2 undo names missing .claude/hooks.json; hook-mask-output.sh exists and must not be blamed.

cases.name: bad-unclassified
cases.why: An explicit Installs field has an unknown target shape. Ignoring it must fail.

cases.name: bad-empty
cases.why: An empty document is not evidence that every promise resolves.

cases.name: bad-near-empty
cases.why: One valid source cannot satisfy the measured production floor of 43.

cases.name: bad-retirement-hides-promise
cases.why: Retirement prose must not hide an affirmative install in the next sentence.

cases.name: bad-placeholder
cases.why: An unsupported runtime placeholder cannot be assumed to resolve.

cases.name: bad-escape
cases.why: A CPP source that escapes the checkout is not a supplied asset.

cases.name: good-fixed
cases.why: 43 distinct CPP source expressions resolve at the production floor.

cases.name: good-retirement
cases.why: Retirement prose and a negative install statement do not promise old missing files.

cases.name: bad-braced-source
cases.why: Review1: braced shell checkout variable must resolve the promised source, not silently bypass extraction.

cases.name: bad-generation-hides-source
cases.why: Review1: a parenthetical creates-a-symlink description does not make a CPP source generated.

cases.name: bad-source-retirement-comment
cases.why: Own probe: retirement in a shell comment cannot hide an active source copy.

cases.name: bad-negative-then-positive
cases.why: Own probe: a historical negative cannot hide a later affirmative now-installs clause.

cases.name: bad-generation-source-operand
cases.why: Review2: a creation statement still needs its CPP source template; from does not create that input.

cases.name: bad-unknown-before-known
cases.why: Review2: a known source cannot hide an unknown preceding promised operand.

cases.name: bad-unknown-after-known
cases.why: An unknown trailing promised operand must fail independently of a known source.

cases.name: bad-braced-home
cases.why: Braced HOME must resolve an installed helper back to its checkout source.

cases.name: bad-source-modifier
cases.why: Unsupported CPP_DIR expansion must be named as unclassified, never silently excluded.

cases.name: bad-generated-cache-hides-install
cases.why: A prior generated destination does not classify a later explicit CPP source promise.

anchors.why: No promised-source-path gate existed before #1587. This deliberately blind substitute returns green for every fixture, demonstrating the control fails without the new check.
